best_model_selection.selection_criterion: Clinical Decision Support Index (CDSI: 40% Sensitivity, 25% PR-AUC, 20% ROC-AUC, 15% Specificity, -10% FNR)
best_model_selection.selection_rationale: Model 'Logistic Regression' was selected as the optimal clinical decision-support model with a CDSI score of 0.6527. It achieves a Sensitivity of 70.1% and a False Negative Rate of only 29.9%, while maintaining 71.6% Specificity and a ROC-AUC of 0.7959. In emergency cardiac deterioration monitoring, failing to identify an unstable patient (False Negative) carries mortal risk, justifying prioritization of sensitivity and PR-AUC over raw accuracy.
